results.title: Who was the guru of Bombay Jayashree?
results.snippet: Jayashri studied Bharatanatyam under Guru K. Kalyanasundaram Pillai of Shri Rajarajeshwari Bharatha Natya Kalamandir, Mumbai. She was also involved in theater with the Amateur Dramatic Club, Mumbai.

results.title: Why is she called Bombay Jayashri?
results.snippet: The story behind her rechristening —from Jayashri Subramaniam to Bombay Jayashri — is an amusing one. As is the tradition in south India, the village's name is prefixed to a classical artiste's, and so, Bombay (where she comes from) got prefixed to Jayashri's name while she was still in Chennai.
